help_texts.confirm: Confirming registers the money as received: the payment is marked successful and its order becomes paid and moves to processing. The customer is notified.
help_texts.fail: Failing marks this payment as failed. The order stays unpaid and the customer can pay it again.

tooltips.refund_unsupported_driver: This gateway's refund API isn't wired yet — issue the refund in the gateway's dashboard.
tooltips.refund_unsupported_crypto: Crypto payments cannot be reversed by NowPayments — arrange any customer reimbursement separately outside Baxela.

success.title: Confirm payment
success.desc: Mark payment #{{id}} as successful? Its order will be marked paid and move to processing.

failed.title: Mark payment as failed
failed.desc: Mark payment #{{id}} as failed? The order stays unpaid and the customer can pay it again.

dialog.title: Issue refund
dialog.subtitle: Ledger refund against payment #{id} — partial amounts allowed.
dialog.manual_note: For manual payments this records that YOU have already returned the money outside Baxela.
dialog.async_note: Some gateways confirm refunds asynchronously: the refund stays processing until the gateway's webhook confirms it.

history.title: Refund history
history.subtitle: Ledger records for payment #{id}
history.reserved_note: Amounts marked as needing reconciliation stay counted against the refundable balance until resolved.
